items.title: Credo Technology Group Holding (CRDO) Secures OCP Approval For Two Optical Telemetry Standards
items.summary: Credo Technology Group Holding (NasdaqGS:CRDO) and Oracle secured OCP Community approval for two new optical telemetry specifications. The open standards cover transceiver telemetry collection and event logging designed to support AI network reliability. Both specifications are intended to encourage broader industry use of consistent monitoring across optical modules used in AI fabrics. items.title: Adobe (ADBE) Brings CX Enterprise Coworker to Major AI Platforms
items.summary: Adobe (NasdaqGS: ADBE) introduced its CX Enterprise Coworker agentic AI into leading third party AI platforms from Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Databricks. The CX Enterprise Coworker is designed to help marketing teams coordinate customer experiences across multiple AI environments rather than only within Adobe's own suite.
